session_migrations.note: model_revisions/model_defaults/model_runtimes/model_requests/model_segments: pinned safetensors registry, promoted defaults, per-host runtime state, request accounting, durable output segments
knowledge_collections/documents/versions/chunks/indexes/answers: immutable document versions, byte-addressed chunks, encrypted index versions, cached answers with citations
calibration_datasets/models/defaults + calibrated_scheduling_enabled meta: datasets, fitted models from verified jobs, scheduler signal
verification_jobs: audit requests, challenges, results, signed statements, disputes
nodes/node_transfers + jobs.location_policy: node identities, credentials (hashes), transfers, execution-location policy
approvals + approval policy meta: bound proposals, decisions, expiry, application records
evaluation_suites/evaluation_runs: versioned suites with hidden items, scored runs
notebooks/notebook_versions: immutable narrative versions with checked links
model_runtimes.warm/drain_reason/drained_at: warmup residency intent and drain records
agent_plans: typed plan drafts, validation, execution bindings

transaction_boundaries: each migration runs in one transaction and is recorded in schema_migrations; migrate is idempotent; live upgrade procedure: backup (SQLite backup API + artifacts + keys) -> migrate -> restart task-owned processes -> smoke test
backward_compatibility: additive tables and nullable columns only; a database at 013 migrates forward without data rewrite; no migration deletes or rewrites artifacts
restore: restore sets the reconciliation gate; nothing economic is resubmitted on start; model/index recovery report lists weights and index versions present/absent
